body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 2, 2026
US dollar stablecoin market cap has climbed to roughly $308B, up $71B (30%) as adoption accelerates one year after the GENIUS Act became law.
Stablecoin News
GENIUS Act rulemaking deadline passes with no final rules
The Fed, OCC, FDIC, NCUA and Treasury all missed the July 18 statutory deadline to finalize federal stablecoin rules, leaving issuers in regulatory limbo ahead of the January 2027 fallback date.
USDC pulls ahead of USDT in transaction volume
Circle's USDC now accounts for about 70% of adjusted stablecoin transaction volume versus USDT's 25%, as total volume hit a record $1.79T in June.
Tether signs MOU with Nairobi Securities Exchange
Tether will pilot USDT and its Hadron platform for instant settlement on Kenya's $26.4B stock exchange, part of a push into emerging-market capital markets.
Tether moves USDT onto Bitcoin via RGB protocol
A native USDT issuance on Bitcoin using the RGB protocol, integrated with Lightning, is rolling out for near-instant, low-cost stablecoin transfers.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Coldcard firmware flaw drains $38M in 25 minutes
A five-year-old build bug caused Coldcard Mk3 wallets to silently use a weak RNG; attackers swept 594 BTC from roughly 500 wallets across 500 transactions on July 31.
Ostium loses $18M in oracle price-feed attack
Attackers gamed Ostium's own oracle infrastructure to manipulate prices and drain funds, the latest in a wave of oracle-targeted DeFi exploits.
Summer.fi exploit drains $6M, vaults halted
A vulnerability in Summer.fi's Lazy Summer vaults was exploited for roughly $6M, prompting the protocol to pause the affected vaults.
Lien Finance hacked for $542K in USDC exploit
The Ethereum DeFi protocol Lien Finance suffered a smart-contract exploit resulting in the loss of $542K in USDC.
